title: AI game jam with $7K in prizes — starts Oct 19th
author: Sol_is_Playful
selftext:
Any AI game devs or designers excited to do a game jam? 👀

I'm helping throw Playful.ai's second Game Jam— an AI game jam with $7K in prizes. Our studio is brand new and the game jam is small...but that's because we're flying on the radar for a bit and all our games are still in stealth. Our founders (and jam judges) include the guy who made Farmville, and the guy who ran AI gaming at Netflix. 

This jam is all about AFK virtual pet AI games. We're hunting for systems that create meaningful bonds between players and digital creatures that grow, evolve, and surprise even when you're not watching.

[**SIGN UP NOW**](https://itch.io/jam/playfulai-jam-afk-edition)**! — jam kicks off Oct 19th**  🎉  
  
Our first game jam was a blast.  
200 sign-ups, 70+ submissions.  
  
The vibe is great.  
Proof is in the [comments](https://itch.io/jam/playfulai-jam-1/topic/5237626/thanks-everyone) from our past participants:  
  
*"Also big thanks to* [*Playful.ai*](http://Playful.ai)  *- I really loved to see something "Pro-Ai-Coding" :) As someone, who is only through these very tools enabled to create, this is a big issue I am facing... As with all things in live, the vibe also has at least two sides, I guess."*

Happy to answer any questions!

comments.author: Katwazere
comments.body: Participated in the first one and hyped for the second, got a team this time around. I highly recommend it if anyone is interested.

comments.author: Dukyyyy
comments.body:
Is it free to use? 
Do I need to download anything?
If it’s free and web based, I’m all in

replies.author: Sol_is_Playful
replies.body: Totally free to join the jam... not sure what you mean about use?

replies.author: Dukyyyy
replies.body: Is it free to use the ai?

replies.author: Sol_is_Playful
replies.body: You're allowed to use any AI tools you're confortable with! Some are free some aren't, that's up to you!

replies.author: Dukyyyy
replies.body: Ok! Is there any platform I have to do it on? Like Godot etc?

replies.author: Sol_is_Playful
replies.body: Nope! Whatever you're comfortable with, you just need to use AI somehow and note how :)

replies.author: EmotionalFan5429
replies.body: You have to create a game during the jam.

comments.author: Deep_Sample_7289
comments.body: I am interested, how to join and what's the rules

replies.author: Deep_Sample_7289
replies.body: Is the llm free to use for the jam ?

replies.author: Sol_is_Playful
replies.body: What llm? You're welcome to use whatever llm you like, we don't have preferences on the tools you use, we're a game studio!

replies.author: Deep_Sample_7289
replies.body: I was wondering what playful.ai is I thought it was an llm or generative?

replies.author: Sol_is_Playful
replies.body: It's a game studio. You have to make an AI game using any tool you'd like, but based on the theme we provide. If you click the link it explains more. Thanks!

comments.author: ianxplosion-
comments.body: People are so used to SaaS token resellers hosting events to promote their business they’re not used to devs hosting a jam just for folks to make games 😂

replies.author: Sol_is_Playful
replies.body: Right? Listen, they told me I could run a jam and gave me a budget so lfg! There's no catch!
